reuse.title: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (2007), Beginners' Guide to Financial Statement
reuse.accepted_inspected_scope: Actual official HTML body inspected, principal statements and their connections, balance-sheet equation, period-versus-date distinction and notes discussion. Page reports February 2007 publication/update. Used as elementary orientation, not a current accounting standard. The chapter does not adopt the guide's informal liquidation shorthand as an equality between recorded equity and realizable sale proceeds, or describe all expenses as contemporaneous cash payments.
reuse.project_use: Historical statement connections only; all case recognition and transaction conventions are stipulated.

reuse.accepted_inspected_scope: Opened actual 30-page primary author PDF from the Continuous-Time Finance course index; PDF header identifies 2016 Foundations of Financial Engineering notes. The already catalogued v10-c06-haugh-discrete uses another author-hosted route and focuses on self-financing/early exercise; this proposal records the additionally inspected single-period scope. No source example or problem is reproduced, no general continuous-time FTAP is imported.
